the relationship between national and local policies in the process of developing SUMPs, and the paper concludes by providing some suggestions for improving the guidelines' effectiveness.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the national policies have an impact on SUMPs but that the impact can vary from one municipality to another, and that it is not always easy to predict the impact.
the national guidelines have an important role in the process of developing SUMPs, although the national policies do not necessarily have to be followed to the letter.
the guidelines are not a binding instrument but rather a reference document for the development and implementation of SUMPs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SUMPs should be prepared with a high degree of flexibility, while at the same time, it should be ensured that they remain consistent with the principles of the guidelines.
SUMPs should not be considered as mere copies of national guidelines.
the national policies are a key factor for the development of SUMPs and the guidelines are an essential element in the development of the national policies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the guidelines can be useful in setting up a common framework of reference for planning mobility in a more sustainable manner.
SUMPs can be prepared in different ways and that it is possible to apply the principles in different ways as long as the main goals of sustainable mobility are not neglected.
SUMPs should be seen as a process rather than as a product and that the guidelines can serve as a valuable source of inspiration and as a tool to facilitate the process.
